map.是。ROI 不含期限，长期低 ROI 可能不如短期高 ROI；需结合回收期/IR: Yes. ROI has no term in it, so a low ROI over a long period can be worse than a high ROI over a short one; look at the payback period and IRR as well.
map.成本应该包含哪些才算准？: What should the cost include to be accurate?
map.应包含取得该项资产的全部支出：买入价款、手续费、税费与后续必需投入。只算买入价会: It should include every outlay required to acquire the asset: the purchase price, fees, taxes and any necessary follow-up investment. Counting only the purchase price overstates the return; for example buying at 100 and selling at 110 looks like 10%, but with 5 of transaction cost the real ROI is only about 4.76%.
